tools.name: search_boats
tools.description: Search the narrowboats, motor boats, sailing boats, RIBs, kayaks, canoes, paddleboards and jet skis for sale on Boatsite now, advertised by their UK owners. Filters: section, make, model, place, price, year, length, berths, engine type, fuel, hull material, engine hours, an included trailer or moori

tools.name: get_listing_detail
tools.description: One Boatsite advert in full: the seller's description, price, the facts they gave, where it is, delivery and how to contact the seller. An advert that has sold or been withdrawn answers with available false and why, and no price.

tools.name: get_recent_listings
tools.description: The newest adverts on Boatsite, up to 20, optionally in one section or under a price.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The sections of Boatsite, how many adverts each has for sale now, and the kinds each can be filtered by.

tools.name: list_makes
tools.description: Makes with adverts for sale on Boatsite now and how many each has, most first. Optionally one section, or makes containing some text.

tools.name: get_price_range
tools.description: The price range of comparable Boatsite adverts for a boat: the low, middle and high price and the adverts it came from, including ones that have sold. It narrows by make and model, then make, then size, then the whole section, and answers from the first that has enough adverts to be reliable. length

tools.name: search
tools.description: Deep-research search of Boatsite adverts for sale. Returns ids, titles and links; pass an id to fetch. Prefer search_boats for filtered results.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Deep-research fetch of one Boatsite advert by the id search returned.

tools.name: list_my_listings
tools.description: The signed-in user's own Boatsite adverts, newest first: drafts, live and sold, each with its price, views, saves and advert link. Needs the user to connect their Boatsite account.

tools.name: get_my_enquiries
tools.description: Messages buyers have sent about the signed-in user's Boatsite adverts, newest first: each enquiry's id, the advert, the buyer's latest message, the unread count and whether the seller has replied. respond_to_enquiry answers one by its id. Needs the user to connect their Boatsite account.

tools.name: get_my_messages
tools.description: The signed-in user's message threads with Boatsite sellers, and the sellers' replies. With no threadId it lists the threads; with one it returns that thread's messages. Enquiries sent with make_enquiry appear here. Needs the user to connect their Boatsite account.

tools.name: respond_to_enquiry
tools.description: Send the seller's reply to a buyer who messaged about one of the signed-in user's Boatsite adverts. The buyer is notified, and the message says an AI assistant sent it on the seller's behalf. It cannot be unsent: show the user the exact reply and send it only once they agree. tools.name: make_enquiry
tools.description: Send a question to the seller of a Boatsite advert on the buyer's behalf. It is saved to the buyer's Boatsite inbox, where the seller's reply arrives, and the seller is notified. tools.name: mark_as_sold
tools.description: Mark one of the signed-in user's Boatsite adverts as sold, with the price it sold for and the day, if the user said. Buyers then see the boat as sold. Needs the user to connect their Boatsite account.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-server" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_my_enquiries, get_my_messages · Private data: get_listing_detail · Public sink: respond_to_enquiry, make_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_my_enquiries, get_my_messages · Private data: get_listing_detail · Public sink: respond_to_enquiry, make_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
